0022600216.text: The Trail Blazers (6-2) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-2) in their 10th game of the season. Portland sits second in the Northwest, one game back of the division-leading Thunder, and fourth in the West after winning six of its last ten and dropping its most recent game. Oklahoma City arrives on a four-game winning streak and is 5-0 at home, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 124-95 loss in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Robert Williams III (rest), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms) and Thomas Sorber (knee).
